page.layout: One printed page, one text block in full width with three diagrams (a parallelogram, a rectangle and a rhombus) set between the paragraphs; the page ends with a catchword-like signature line "C" and a Greek word at the right. A digitiser's link at the foot is left out. Diagrams are not text and are described under notes.

main_text.p: qualibus lateribus, & rectis cõstant angulis, ut τε¬ τράγωνα, id est, quadrata. Quædam nec ὀρθογώ¬ νια nec ἰσόπλευρα, ut ῥομβοειδὴ, rhombi figuræ similia. Quædam ὀρθογώνια quidem, sed non ἰσόπλευρα, ut τὰ ἑτερομήκη, id est, altera parte longiora seu quadrangula. Quædam deniq; ἰσό¬ πλευρα quidem, sed non ὀρθογώνια, ut ῥομβοι rhombi ueri.

Quæ uero nõ παραλληλόγραμμα sunt, Aut duas habent lineas æquabiliter distantes, ut παρα¬ πέζια mensulæ, & horum quædam sunt ἰσοσκε¬ λῆ, quorum duo sunt æqualia crura, quædam σκα¬ ληνὰ id est, totæ uariæ: Aut nullas prorsus paral¬ lelos lineas habent, ut ῥαμπεζοειδὴ.

page.notes: Diagrams: a parallelogram (left, upper), a rectangle (right, upper) and a rhombus (centre, below), with small tally marks in red ink beside them; these are not printed text. Greek words in the text are transcribed as best read from a small, worn scan; several are doubtful and may contain errors. The final Greek word of the first paragraph and the line "ῥομβοι" are unclear. The catchword "πεν=" at the foot right is read as printed and may be a catchword.
